verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-action capability, such as selecting many traces, datasets, or log items and acting on them at once. Related features exist: experiments run against datasets, review queues organize sessions, traces, and spans, and decision-model metrics score large volumes of text. These are adjacent evaluation and review features, not bulk operations across items, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
